dsh-turn-rail is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Codex-style auto-hiding right-edge turn rail: edge-peek show/hide, per-turn tooltip, in-rail search, and a scrolling 30-turn window for long sessions.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b02c5981cd8e73c92430.html
